candidateAudit.title: Goodbye, Meli! ❤️🚢 Zwei Jahre lang war Meli im Rahmen ihres Praktikums Teil des Badeschiffs – und es war eine große Freude, mit ihr zusammenzuarbeiten. Mit ihrem Fleiß und ihrer o
candidateAudit.text: Goodbye, Meli! ❤️🚢 Zwei Jahre lang war Meli im Rahmen ihres Praktikums Teil des Badeschiffs – und es war eine große Freude, mit ihr zusammenzuarbeiten. Mit ihrem Fleiß und ihrer ordentlichen Arbeitsweise hat sie schnell einen Platz in der Crew gefunden und uns mit ihrer fröhlichen Art und ihrer Offenheit immer wieder zum Lachen gebracht. Was Meli am meisten vermissen wird? 💛 Ihren Kollegen Georg – oder besser gesagt: mit ihm zu lachen und ihn auch mal zu ärgern. Georg hat ihr immer geduldig alles gezeigt, alle Fragen beantwortet und war dabei jederzeit für einen Schmäh zu haben. 💛 Ihre Chefin Steffi, die sie nie mit einer Herausforderung allein gelassen hat. 💛 Die Bierfässer, die für sie aussahen wie kleine, dicke Schweinchen. 🐷🍺 💛 Das genüssliche Zertreten von Kartons. 💛 Das liebe Küchenteam. 💛 Und ganz besonders den schwarzen Staubsauger, der – da ist sich Meli sicher – einfach viel besser gesaugt hat als alle, die danach gekommen sind. 😄 Liebe Meli, wir danken dir für die gemeinsame Zeit, für dein Lachen, deine Herzlichkeit, deine Arbeit und dein Engagement. Wir wünschen dir von Herzen alles Gute für deinen weiteren Weg! 🍀 Auch das Facility-Team möchte nochmal ganz besonders Danke sagen; wir werden dich sehr vermissen, du warst eine super Kollegin! Hoffentlich sehen wir uns bald wieder! Du bist bei uns am Badeschiff jederzeit herzlich willkommen, alles Liebe und sonnige Grüße von der gesamten Crew des Badeschiffs! ❤️🚢

candidateAudit.text: First release for July is out!❤️‍🔥 Reinaldo Chilito | El Paraiso Nectarine | Orange | Florals Colombia Pink Bourbon | Washed imported via semillacoffee Reinaldo was born and raised in El Purutal, San Agustín, Huila, where agricultural work shaped daily life from an early age. Limited access to education meant he left school after the second grade and spent much of his childhood helping his family cultivate sugarcane, panela, corn, beans, cassava, and coffee. Through years of work on his parents’ farm and neighboring properties, he developed the skills and experience that would later allow him to establish his own agricultural project. At fourteen, Reinaldo received a small portion of his family’s land to cultivate independently. Alongside seasonal work on neighboring farms, he gradually saved enough money to purchase a plot of his own. With support from Colombia’s coffee growers federation, he planted his first 800 Caturra trees and began building the foundation of his coffee farm. Together with his wife, Mariela, whom he met in his early twenties, he expanded the farm over the following decades, acquiring additional land and steadily increasing coffee production while continuing to grow food crops for household use. In 2016, Reinaldo planted 3,000 Pink Bourbon trees after seeing the success of the variety on neighboring farms. As he learned more about specialty coffee, he became interested in producing coffees with higher quality potential and greater value. It's time for another Release!🌟 Eliecer Nuñez Osorio | Finca Mirador Apricot | Rosehip Tea | Panela Colombia Colombia | Washed imported via semillacoffee Don Eliecer Nuñez Osorio was born and raised in Ricabrisa, Tarqui, Huila, where coffee cultivation has long been part of everyday life. From an early age, he worked alongside his father on the family farm, learning the practical skills of coffee production through harvesting, weeding, and maintaining the fields. Although he completed primary school, he chose to dedicate himself to agriculture, seeing rural work as both a livelihood and a long-term project for his family. At eighteen, Don Eliecer began planting his own coffee plots, initially with Caturra before establishing his first thousand trees of the Colombia variety. This early success encouraged him to continue investing in coffee production. In 2005, an inheritance from his father allowed him to consolidate the land that would become his farm. Throughout this process, his wife, Ana Yeni Osorio Cruz, has been a constant partner in managing the farm and supporting their shared goals. In recent years, Don Eliecer has focused increasingly on specialty coffee, seeking to improve quality and create greater value from his work. Through relationships with producers and collaborators connected to Monkaaba, he began refining his production practices and exploring new opportunities for his coffee. Daily life revolved around agricultural work, long walks to school, and household responsibilities that shaped his understanding of rural life from an early age. After his family relocated to La Argentina, he continued his education while helping his father on the farm, gradually developing a deeper connection to coffee cultivation. At twelve years old, Don Eleicer received a small plot of land from his father, an early sign of trust and responsibility. Following his military service, he returned to farming and invested his savings in coffee production. Together with his wife, he established a home and continued expanding his agricultural project. Over time, he became increasingly involved in specialty coffee, seeing it as an opportunity to create greater value and long-term sustainability for his family and farm. Today, Don Eleicer cultivates Pink Bourbon on Finca El Jardín in La Palmita, San Agustín, Huila. The 4.5-hectare farm sits at 1,980 meters above sea level, with two hectares dedicated to coffee. Ripe cherries are selectively harvested every three weeks, fermented for twelve hours before pulping, followed by a thirty-six-hour second fermentation and a drying period of fifteen to twenty days. candidateAudit.text: Next June Release! A really nice and comfy flavor profile - prefect daily driver😌 Ivan Junqueira Ribeiro | Fazenda do Cruzeiro Roasted Hazelnut | Dried Fruits | Milk Chocolate Brazil Yellow Catucai | Natural imported via cafeimportseurope This coffee comes from Fazenda do Cruzeiro, a large and historically rooted farm managed by Ivan Junqueira Ribeiro in Brazil’s Campo das Vertentes region. Established in 1923, the farm spans over 1000 hectares, with a significant portion dedicated to coffee cultivation across multiple varieties. It is part of the Sancoffee cooperative, which focuses on quality-driven production and building long term relationships between producers and international buyers. Within this scale, coffees like this are separated as “Farm Select” lots. These are traceable to a single farm and represent a step toward more differentiated quality in a context where production is often associated with volume. This approach allows producers to receive more direct value for quality while maintaining the efficiency that defines Brazilian coffee production. Harvesting combines manual and mechanical methods, with a focus on collecting ripe cherries. After harvest, the coffee is processed as a natural. Cherries are spread on patios or drying beds and left to dry intact for around 20 to 25 days, depending on weather conditions. During this time, the fruit slowly dries around the seed, and the coffee is regularly turned to ensure even drying and prevent defects. candidateAudit.title: Das Demeter-Prinzip, dem Boden durch bestimmte Methoden zusätzliche Informationen bzw. Lebendigkeit zuzuführen, findet sich für uns metaphorisch in den Weinen von slobodne wieder.
candidateAudit.text: Das Demeter-Prinzip, dem Boden durch bestimmte Methoden zusätzliche Informationen bzw. Lebendigkeit zuzuführen, findet sich für uns metaphorisch in den Weinen von slobodne wieder. Sie sind nicht Demeter-zertifiziert, doch schlägt sich die Geschichte ihres Weingutes, die Emotionen der Familie und die ehrliche und unverfälschte Herangehensweise an das Handwerk des Weinmachens deutlich im Geschmack nieder. Wir könnten hier nun sehr lange darüber schreiben, aber das hat schon thegrapereset ausführlich getan, definitiv lesenswert! (Link in unserer Bio) 👉Wie die Theorie in der Praxis schmeckt, kann jeder bei uns oder direkt bei Slobodne Vinarstvo kosten 👈 🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱🌱 For us, the Demeter principle of enriching the soil with additional information and vitality through specific practices is reflected metaphorically in the wines of slobodne. While they are not Demeter-certified, the history of their winery, the emotions of the family, and their honest, unadulterated approach to the craft of winemaking are clearly expressed in the taste of their wines. We could write at great length about this, but thegrapereset has already done so in much greater detail — definitely worth a read! (Link in our bio) 👉And if you’d like to find out how this philosophy tastes in practice, you’re welcome to try the wines with us or directly at Slobodne Vinarstvo👈 #glacisbeisl #naturalwine #slobodnevinarstvo

candidateAudit.title: 🇬🇧 Only 16 days left until the official start of summer! ☀️ Which also means there are only up to 16 days left to enjoy our Primavera focaccia. I have to admit, it's currently my
candidateAudit.text: 🇬🇧 Only 16 days left until the official start of summer! ☀️ Which also means there are only up to 16 days left to enjoy our Primavera focaccia. I have to admit, it's currently my favourite focaccia on the menu. Our toasted sourdough focaccia is spread with almond cream and topped with rocket dressed in a lemon vinaigrette, poached spring onions, preserved lemons and sheep's cheese from Vorarlberg. It's fresh, crunchy and creamy, with a lovely acidity and a delicate marzipan-like almond aroma. For me, it's the perfect flavour of early summer. 🌱✨ 🇦🇹 Es sind nur noch 16 Tage bis zum offiziellen Sommeranfang! ☀️ Und das bedeutet: Unsere Focaccia „Primavera“ gibt es nur noch maximal 16 Tage auf der Karte. Ich muss zugeben: Gerade ist sie meine Lieblings-Focaccia auf unserer Speisekarte. Unsere getoastete Sauerteig-Focaccia wird mit Mandelcreme bestrichen und anschließend mit Rucola in Zitronendressing, pochierten Frühlingszwiebeln, Salzzitronen und Schafkäse aus Vorarlberg belegt. Das Ergebnis ist frisch und knackig, mit einer schönen Säure, Cremigkeit und einem feinen, leicht marzipanartigen Aroma der Mandeln. Wer sie noch probieren möchte, sollte nicht mehr allzu lange warten. 🌿 #ViennaFood #WienIsst #Focaccia #SeasonalEating

candidateAudit.title: 🍇🌱In the shadow of the Uhudler Grapes. People often describe our garden restaurant as an oasis or hidden gem in the middle of the city—and that’s no coincidence! A great deal of
candidateAudit.text: 🍇🌱In the shadow of the Uhudler Grapes. People often describe our garden restaurant as an oasis or hidden gem in the middle of the city—and that’s no coincidence! A great deal of time and love goes into caring for our garden, and you can see and feel the difference. From the very beginning, preserving the typical tree population of a traditional Viennese guest garden—walnut, chestnut, and linden trees—has been just as important to us as planting new ones. Another key source of shade in summer are the “Uhudler” grapevines, which wind their way through our garden and bring the unique charm of a countryside Heuriger into the heart of the city. Nestled between the mqwien and the bustling Mariahilferstraße shopping district, we offer a retreat from the summer heat—and in winter, thanks to our sheltered location, protection from the cold Viennese wind. During the Advent season, a cup of punch or mulled wine in our garden can make you forget the chill altogether. #glacisbeisl #moderntavern #vienneseclassic

candidateAudit.title: 🌱🍇Circus @ Glacis Beisl With Aci Urbajs and his wines Glacis Beisl started the journey towards natural wine about 15 years ago. Together with radikonwines , terpin_wine and vina_
candidateAudit.text: 🌱🍇Circus @ Glacis Beisl With Aci Urbajs and his wines Glacis Beisl started the journey towards natural wine about 15 years ago. Together with radikonwines , terpin_wine and vina_cotar, organic.anarchy turned a simple pleasure drink into an experience, opened the door to a whole new world (which in fact is not new, but you know what we mean 😉) and made us focus on the origin of wine: nature. Through respect for nature, wines like Organic Anarchy are created. Unconventional and unpredictable, a vibrant product that becomes even more alive and tangible once you get to know the people who create it. That’s why it was both a pleasure and a great joy for us to welcome Aci and his Circus to Glacis Beisl. To bring the spirit of his Rifnik vineyard to the center of Vienna and share it with others. It was also a pleasure to see that the idea of Kmetija Urbajs has now begun to be handover to the younger generation Tina and Ziga, who create wine, cider, fermented tea and many more products Rifnik is gifting. You can enter this world and enjoy a variety of vintages at Glacis Beisl anytime and in future some more products will come (: #organicanarchy #aciurbajs #naturalwine

candidateAudit.text: This release is super special!🔥 Oscar Hernandez | Los Nogales Lavender | Lemon Verbena | Lime Colombia Orange Bourbon | Washed & Dried with Lavender imported via chicas_industry Oscar is a third-generation farmer who grows coffee in the south of the department of Huila, near the town of Bruselas. He is an energetic person, always positive and innovative, not only for his family but also for the wider environment. His father, Ricaurte Hernandez, was the first to prove what we know today: that the best coffees from all over Colombia can be found in Bruselas. In 2006, he won the Colombian Cup of Excellence and, as the locals say, spread the word. Ricaurte put Bruselas, and the entire department of Huila, on the map of fine coffee. Oscar continues this tradition, and thanks to him and his approach, Nogales is a centre of innovation and information for all the proactive farmers in the area. This coffee comes from the Yarumo lot at Finca Nogales, where Orange Bourbon is grown exclusively at the highest point of the farm. The variety has adapted to cooler conditions while still benefiting from strong sunlight due to its position. As one of the newer plantings, it is continuously observed and refined, with each harvest offering new insights into its potential. Production at Finca Nogales emphasizes careful selection and controlled processing. Harvesting is done manually, with pickers selecting only fully ripe cherries to preserve the integrity of the variety. candidateAudit.title: 🇬🇧 #Throwback to our “The G.O.A.T” Winter Edition ❄️ As always, we start with our homemade sourdough focaccia, lightly toasted. Topped with goat camembert from j.lingenhel , made
candidateAudit.text: 🇬🇧 #Throwback to our “The G.O.A.T” Winter Edition ❄️ As always, we start with our homemade sourdough focaccia, lightly toasted. Topped with goat camembert from j.lingenhel , made locally in Vienna’s 3rd district. We fall in love with his cheeses all over again every single time 🥰 Finished with winter spinach, cranberries, Boskoop apple and verjus. It was one of our most popular focaccias — almost everyone ordered it! We’re currently working on a summery version, but in the meantime you can enjoy our asparagus focaccia with stracciatella and Piedmont hazelnuts. It has officially replaced “The G.O.A.T” for now… but we’re sure it’ll be back 😉 Stay tuned! 🇦🇹 #Throwback zu unserer Kreation „The G.O.A.T“ Winter Edition ❄️ Wie immer starten wir mit unserer hausgemachten Sauerteig-Focaccia, leicht getoastet. Darauf kommt Ziegencamembert von Johannes Lingenhel, direkt vor Ort im 3. Bezirk gemacht. Wir verlieben uns jedes Mal aufs Neue in seinen Käse 🥰 Dazu Winterspinat, Cranberries, Boskop-Apfel und Verjus. Es war eine unserer beliebtesten Focaccias — fast jede*r hat sie bestellt! Gerade arbeiten wir an einer sommerlichen Version, aber meanwhile könnt ihr unsere Spargel-Focaccia mit Stracciatella und piemontesischen Haselnüssen genießen. Sie hat nämlich „The G.O.A.T“ ersetzt … aber keine Sorge, sie kommt bestimmt zurück 😉 Stay tuned! #naturalwine #sourdoughfocaccia #winebarvienna viennaeats viennafoodie

candidateAudit.text: Heute erreichen in Indien die farbenfrohen Feierlichkeiten des Diwali – des Lichterfestes – ihren Höhepunkt. candidateAudit.text: Das neunerhaus Café ist ein Ort der Begegnung - für alle. Ein Wohnzimmer für obdach- und wohnungslose Menschen, wo man kostenlos essen, Kaffee trinken und einfach Mensch sein kann. Doch das Café ist dringend auf Spenden angewiesen - und braucht unsere Unterstützung. Uns liegt diese Ort sehr am Herzen. Deshalb rufen wir gemeinsam mit Euch zum Spenden auf! Lasst uns helfen, damit das neunerhaus Café bleiben kann - als Ort der Hoffnung. Unser Ziel: 200.000 €. Jeder Beitrag zählt, ganz gleich wie hoch. Denn: GEMEINSAM ist vieles leichter. https://www.neunerhaus.at/spenden-wirtinnen

candidateAudit.text: 🎉 Der Bitzinger Augustinerkeller feiert 70 Jahre und startet neu durch! 🎉 Seit 70 Jahren ist der Augustinerkeller ein Fixpunkt in der Wiener Gastroszene – ein Ort, an dem Tradition und Wiener Gemütlichkeit zuhause sind. candidateAudit.text: Tolle Neugkeiten vom Würstelstand: Unter shop.bitzinger.wien kannst du dir ein Stück Wien nach Hause holen! Erlebe den einzigartigen Geschmack Wiens direkt bei dir zuhause! Mit den exklusiven Würsten vom legendären Bitzinger Würstelstand kannst du jetzt die Wiener Würstelstandkultur jederzeit genießen. Sepp Bitzinger, ein Meister seines Fachs, hat all seine Erfahrung und Leidenschaft in die Entwicklung dieser besonderen Rezepte und Mischungen gesteckt. Unsere Würste sind mehr als nur eine Mahlzeit – sie sind ein Stück Wiener Tradition. Jedes Rezept ist sorgfältig von Sepp Bitzinger selbst erarbeitet worden, um dir den authentischen Geschmack Wiens zu bieten. Dabei stehen Qualität und Genuss an oberster Stelle. Ob knackige Käsekrainer oder die würzige Seppbreziner oder die klassischen Sacherwürstel – jede Wurst ist ein kleines Meisterwerk und spiegelt die reiche Kultur und Geschichte der Wiener Würstelstände wider.

candidateAudit.text: Hi ihr Lieben, Weil einige verwirrt waren wegen der neuen Öffnungszeiten und fragen, wann es wieder die „Alten“ geben wird, wollten wir hiermit die Neuigkeiten verkünden. Juli wird unser letzter Monat in der Praterstraße sein. Wir schließen zum spätestens 31.7.23. Aber wo sich eine Tür schließt, öffnet sich eine Neue: Wir arbeiten gerade an einem 100% Veganen Konzept für eine neue Location. Noch wissen wir nicht, wann und wo wir genau eröffnen werden, aber nach der Sommerpause wird es mit uns weitergehen! candidateAudit.text: The last week our thoughts and prayers have been with the Ukranian people and all those suffering on the account of this senseless war. A campaign was brought to my attention called #CookForUkraine initiated by the wonderful oliahercules encouraging the sharing of Ukranian recipes and donating to those in need. We have decided to join in and will be cooking Borscht this week. 2 € of each Borscht sold will go to #aerzteohnegrenzen and we will also set up a donation box for additional donations. For the time being this campaign will last one week. In the meantime, lets pray for peace! #prayforpeace #cookforukraine #solidaritywithukraine #nowar #aerzteohnegrenzen

candidateAudit.title: Not so long ago I was wondering where everyone disappeared to and now we are officially in March and Spring is in the air. 🌱People are out and about, some even wearing sunglasses
candidateAudit.text: Not so long ago I was wondering where everyone disappeared to and now we are officially in March and Spring is in the air. 🌱People are out and about, some even wearing sunglasses because the sun is so strong.☀️ There is a sense of hope and renewal and I am truly happy to see so many new and familiar faces here every day, some even coming from far away districts which is truly an honor for us. In case you’re new to this page I‘d like to introduce myself. My name is Aleksandra. I‘m a native Canadian with Croatian roots. I grew up in Toronto and came to study classical singing in Vienna. To make a long story short, I married an Austrian, had three kids and discovered my love for cooking and particularly plantbased cooking . Last year me and my husband opened the bröselei, a place where people can nourish themselves with healthy, organic and gluten-free food and soothe their sweet tooth as well 🍰. My mission is to make healthy vegan food accessible to a wider audience regardless of their ideological beliefs. Everyone is welcome here! If you have any questions or requests, drop me a note. I would to hear from you! See you soon in the bröselei!

candidateAudit.title: My next winter vegetable hero is lacinato kale or otherwise known as dinosaur kale, maybe because the ridges on the leaves look like the skin of a giant reptile?? In any case, ther
candidateAudit.text: My next winter vegetable hero is lacinato kale or otherwise known as dinosaur kale, maybe because the ridges on the leaves look like the skin of a giant reptile?? In any case, there is so much goodness in this wonderful vegetable and is known for being one of the most antioxidant rich and protein rich vegetables. Yes, that’s right, I said protein. The flavour is wonderfully complex, with sweet and bitter notes. It harmonizes wonderfully with garlic, lemon and olive oil and also with winter squashes and more assertive flavours like olives, capers. Any which way you use it you will be awarded with a vibrant green color on your plate. In the bröselei it often appears in soups, stews, salads and bowls. Have you had it before and how do you like to use it? If you’re luckily for a good source I have one for you in Vienna. Every Saturday you kind find it kutschkermarkt in the 18th district. Fyi tomorrow is bowl day in the bröselei. This week I‘ll be making a Edamame rice bowl with teriyaki sauce. Hope to see you there. Have a nice evening!

candidateAudit.text: This cake was a special request from a customer. What looks like a chocolate cake is a layer of chocolate ganache and hiding underneath are two layers of poppyseed cake with raspberry jam. I topped it off with sliced almonds and “Alles Liebe” ( a floral herbal blend from sonnentor) because I love flowers so much. If you’re looking for a particular cake that you haven’t seen before or have any dietary restrictions besides gluten-free or vegan please fell free to approach me. I love creating new cakes and fulfilling your wishes. This past weekend I made a birthday cake only sweetened with dates and a little maple syrup. My customer was so happy! Such moments feed my soul! 🥰

candidateAudit.title: Gluten-free and vegan baking is one of the most challenging things that I’ve encountered on my wellness journey. Luckily I don’t have coeliac disease or other auto-immune disorders
candidateAudit.text: Gluten-free and vegan baking is one of the most challenging things that I’ve encountered on my wellness journey. Luckily I don’t have coeliac disease or other auto-immune disorders so I do eat gluten occasionally but I envisioned the bröselei as a place where people with many sensitivities can eat without questioning what they are eating and that they can enjoy delicious treats that are not only healthy but truly delicious. Creating desserts that are consistently delicious and also texturally spot on is sometimes hit and miss but when we do succeed it is all the more rewarding. This particular bundt cake was one such experiment that turned out exceptionally well. Just look at that crumb! So moist, chocolatey and so irresistible. We will continue to refine our recipes to ensure the utmost pleasure and feel free to stop by and try our range of desserts. Most often you’ll find chocolate tahini cookies, hazelnut ganache brownies, apple streusel cake, carrot cake with cashew cream cheese, blueberry cheesecake and chocolate cake. All our desserts are sweetened naturally and our sweeteners of choice are either coconut blossom sugar, maple syrup or dates. Please let us know what cake you would like to see in our rotation. I would love to expand our repertoire in the near future. 🍫🍩🍰❤️#

candidateAudit.title: Whether you eat a plant-based diet or any other kind of diet, I am sure we can all agree that vegetables are truly beautiful. Swiss chard brings to mind the famous phrase „Eat the
candidateAudit.text: Whether you eat a plant-based diet or any other kind of diet, I am sure we can all agree that vegetables are truly beautiful. Swiss chard brings to mind the famous phrase „Eat the rainbow!“ 🌈 and this particular variety is even called rainbow chard. How fantastic is that? Unfortunately the colors get somewhat lost in cooking but I love cooking with it and its naturally salty so you can reduce your salt content when cooking with it. Here in the bröselei it makes its appearance especially in stews and curries. Its also great as a side dish simply steamed or braised. So, let me know, do you like swiss chard and how do you like to prepare it? ✌️🌱

candidateAudit.text: Weekend is here and I’m planning my culinary projects. High up on my list of favorites is pizza, especially since lockdown. I think I‘ll attempt a sourdough as well. My favorite pizzeria in Vienna is #pizzeriavero and they make an amazing sourdough pizza and even have a gluten-free version with buckwheat flour. Since I’ve been getting quite a lot of requests for cakes I just wanted to say that the sooner you place your order the better. candidateAudit.text: Besides relaxing, I mostly spend my weekends trying new recipes or attempting to get better at making sushi or some other culinary project. I must say it is more challenging than it looks. The rice has to be the perfect texture and temperature to cut. Mine was too slimy and wet so I had trouble cutting it. Not to mention, it takes FOREVER. My kids were asking every five minutes , „When are they finally ready?“! In the end they tasted great and I ended up having deep respect for sushi masters. 🍣 🙏 Happy Monday! 😘😘 • • • •
